name: Ordiscan
description: Bitcoin Ordinals and Runes data — inscriptions, runes and the UTXOs holding them, by address or ID. x402-gated at $0.01 per request in USDC on Base, with an MCP server so an assistant can query Bitcoin metaprotocol state directly.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: No account needed on the x402 path. An unauthenticated request returns 402: 'Send a payment via the x402 protocol to access this resource, or sign up for an account and an API key.' Sign ERC-3009 for 0.01 USDC on Base and retry. MCP server source: https://github.com/ordiscan/ordiscan-mcp
